definitions.single_dispatch: At most one HTTP POST per consumed ARE reservation, including any credential callback.
definitions.request_bound: The complete serialized model request and output reservation are checked before transport.
definitions.response_bound: A finite total response-byte limit and wall-clock deadline cover headers and body.

product.outcome: Use the existing ARE recycling loop with an inspectable HTTP adapter

business.hypothesis: Reduce uncontrolled transport behavior; reliability and cost gains remain to be measured

rules: Input meter covers complete immutable body and model framing
Dispatch measurement must match gate observation
Response completion tokens must be within requested cap
Uncertain outcomes stay blocked on resume
No embedded endpoint credentials or unencrypted remote HTTP

open_questions: Codex internal host loop remains separate
ChatGPT login is not provided by this adapter
